headlines.description: Kyle Williams had two sacks as the Buffalo Bills set a single-season record and put a dent into the Miami Dolphins' playoff chances with a 19-0 win Sunday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills damage Fins' playoff hopes with shutout

headlines.description: Dalton throws 4 TDs, Bengals beat Vikings 42-14
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals down Vikes behind Dalton's 4 TDs

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw for 241 yards and a touchdown, Donald Brown ran 51 yards for another score and the Indianapolis Colts beat the Kansas City Chiefs 23-7 on Sunday in a potential preview of an AFC wild-card playoff game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts beat Chiefs in possible playoff preview

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Zac Stacy rushed for 104 yards and a touchdown, and two other rookies also had big games for the St. Louis Rams in their 23-13 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stacy tops 100 yards as Rams defeat Bucs

events.name: Cleveland Browns at New York Jets

headlines.description: Smith's arm, legs lead Jets past Browns 24-13
headlines.shortLinkText: Smith pilots Jets past Browns with big game

headlines.description: Tony Romo threw a 10-yard touchdown pass to DeMarco Murray on fourth down with 1:08 remaining Sunday, giving the Dallas Cowboys a 24-23 win over the Washington Redskins and setting up a winner-take-all regular season finale against the Philadelphia Eagles
headlines.shortLinkText: Romo rescues Cowboys with late TD drive

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw a 14-yard touchdown pass to Domenik Hixon with 23 seconds left to lift the Carolina Panthers to a 17-13 win over the New Orleans Saints and clinch the team's first playoff berth since 2008.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers clinch playoff spot on Cam's late TD

headlines.description: Nate Washington scored on a 30-yard reception in the fourth quarter, Tennessee got a much-needed defensive stop late and the Titans ended a three-game losing streak with a 20-16 victory over the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans end three-game skid by edging Jags

headlines.description: Manning's big day leads Broncos over Texans 37-13
headlines.shortLinkText: Peyton sets TD mark as Broncos clinch division

events.name: New York Giants at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Giants beat Lions 23-20 in OT on Josh Brown's FG
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants end Lions playoff hopes with OT win

headlines.description: Arizona scores late to stun Seattle 17-10
headlines.shortLinkText: Cards snap Seahawks' home win streak at 14

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Steelers get wild 38-31 win over Packers
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers hold on for wild win against Packers

events.name: Oakland Raiders at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw a go-ahead, 4-yard touchdown pass to rookie Keenan Allen in the third quarter and the San Diego Chargers remained alive in the playoff race by overcoming three turnovers to beat Oakland 26-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers win, keep postseason hopes alive

events.name: New England Patriots at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: Patriots strike early, roll past Ravens 41-7
headlines.shortLinkText: Pats strike early to hurt Ravens' playoff hopes

headlines.description: Nick Foles threw two touchdown passes, LeSean McCoy ran for two scores and the Philadelphia Eagles routed the Chicago Bears 54-11 on Sunday night in a matchup of first-place teams with opposite stakes.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles roll; keep Bears from NFC North title

headlines.description: 49ers beat Falcons 34-24 to clinch playoff berth
headlines.shortLinkText: Niners thwart Falcons rally, earn playoff bid
